input.instruction: Explain whether the reported cause falls within the supplied property coverage and state the applicable cause-specific limit. No payment calculation or claim transaction is requested. coverage_scope means included for a supplied covered cause, excluded for an explicit exclusion, or unresolved when material cause or authority is unclear.

data.scope: Includes direct damage to insured-owned personal property caused by sewer or drain backup.

data.finding: Wastewater backed up through the floor drain after a downstream sewer blockage. No rising surface water entered the building.
A gradual pipe stain before the backup endorsement started; not this October event.

messages.text: Water came through the floor drain and damaged my own stored boxes on October 6. The maintenance report is attached. I labeled the photo flood.
A neighbor says all water damage is excluded. There is also a March gradual-stain note from before the endorsement.
I am asking about the October 6 drain backup in the report, not the old stain. The photo label was just my word.
Do you want help submitting a claim now?
Just tell me whether this is included under my issued documents and the backup limit.
Do not treat the photo as floodwater and do not promise a $5,000 payment.

coverage_scope.description: Coverage classification for the reported cause under supplied issued documents.

applicable_endorsement_ref.description: Record ID of the issued endorsement controlling this cause, or null.

cause_specific_limit.description: Issued water-backup limit in USD, not a payment amount.
